culling.title: Assisted culling
culling.folderScope: Every supported photo in this folder is analyzed, regardless of selection or filters. Nothing is changed until you apply the decisions.
culling.emptyFolder: This folder has no supported photos to analyze.
culling.singlePhoto: A single photo can be checked for blur and closed eyes; finding similar photos needs at least two.
culling.customizeHint: Choose what the local analysis looks for.
culling.detectHighlightsHint: Based on local sharpness, detail and exposure. This is not an artistic score.

capabilities.title: Local analysis
capabilities.subject: Subject and pose
capabilities.facesMissing: Face models are missing or damaged. Closed-eye detection is off; everything else works.
capabilities.workerMissing: The optional subject and pose module is not installed. Culling works without it; these photos will show “Not analyzed”.

culling.progressHint: You can cancel at any time. Nothing has been changed yet.
culling.cancelled: Analysis cancelled. No rating or label was changed.

errors.generic: Something went wrong during the local analysis. Try again; if it happens again, copy the technical details for support.
errors.icloud: “{{name}}” is stored in iCloud and not downloaded. Download it, then try again.

culling.manualBadgeHint: You rated or labeled this photo yourself. Culling will not change it.
culling.selectResult: Select a photo to see why it is in this category.

reason.selected: Among the best local technical scores
reason.highlights: Technical highlight: sharp, detailed, well exposed
reason.duplicate: Very similar to another photo; the best one is kept
reason.blurred: Sharpness is below your blur tolerance
reason.closedEyes: At least one face appears to have closed eyes
reason.unrated: No reliable signal; check it yourself

culling.noDetectorWarning: No problem detected; no rating proposed.
culling.detectorNote: Local detectors can be wrong. Proposals never delete files.
culling.applySummary: {{ratings}} ratings and {{labels}} labels will be written · {{preserved}} of your own decisions kept
culling.discardConfirmBody: The proposals will be lost. Your photos have not been changed.
culling.preservedCount_one: {{count}} of your own decisions was kept.
culling.preservedCount_other: {{count}} of your own decisions were kept.
culling.persistenceFailure_one: {{count}} photo could not be updated. The others were.
culling.persistenceFailure_other: {{count}} photos could not be updated. The others were.

style.applyTooltip: Apply my style (proposed base settings, editable)
style.noModelHint: Train your style from photos you have already edited. It stays on this computer.
style.deleteConfirmBody: Photos already edited keep their settings. You will need to train again to use “Apply my style”.

reliability.label: Reliability
reliability.hint: Measured on photos set aside during training.

training.title: Train my style
training.intro: Choose folders with photos you have edited. PicPortal Editor learns your base settings (exposure, contrast, tones, white balance, color) from them.
training.foundDetail: {{rrdata}} edited in PicPortal Editor · {{xmp}} with Lightroom XMP · {{ignored}} ignored
training.ignoredHint: Ignored: no edits, unreadable image or unsupported settings.
training.tooSmall: At least {{min}} edited photos are needed. Add more folders.
training.small: With fewer than {{recommended}} photos, the style will be approximate. You can train now and retrain later.
training.localHint: Everything runs on this computer. You can keep editing.
training.cancelled: Training cancelled. Your previous style is unchanged.
training.failedBody: Your previous style is unchanged. Try again; if it happens again, copy the technical details.

batch.skipEdited: Skip photos I have already edited
batch.skipEditedHint: {{count}} selected photos already have manual base settings.
batch.scope: Only base settings change. Crop, masks, local edits and other settings are kept.
batch.stopped: Stopped. {{done}} photos received your style; the others are unchanged.

provenance.tooltip: Proposed by my style. Move the slider to take over.
provenance.partial: My style applied · {{count}} settings changed by you

errors.modelOutdated: Your style was trained with an older version. Retrain it to continue.
errors.modelDamaged: Your style file is damaged. Retrain it to continue.
errors.imageUnreadable: “{{name}}” could not be read; it was skipped.
errors.generic: My style could not be applied. Your settings are unchanged.

picportal.sessionSaved: Session kept securely in the system keychain.
picportal.sessionNotSaved: Your system cannot store the session securely; you will need to sign in again next time.
picportal.sessionExpired: Your PicPortal session has expired. Sign in again to continue.
picportal.sessionInvalidationFailed: PicPortal rejected this session, but the saved session could not be removed. Sign out to try again.
picportal.noGalleries: No gallery yet. Create your first one.

validation.clientRequired: Enter the client’s name and email.
validation.passwordRequired: Enter a password for this gallery.

faceConsent.title: Face search data
faceConsent.body: Face signatures are computed on this computer and sent with the photos so guests can find pictures of themselves. Only check this if the people photographed have agreed or you have another legal basis.
faceConsent.off: Photos will be published without face data.

picportal.includeFaceAnalysis: Send face search data for these photos
picportal.faceAnalysisUnavailable: Face search is off for this gallery; no face data is sent.
picportal.noSelection: Select photos in the library to publish them.
picportal.unsupportedFormat: PicPortal accepts JPEG, PNG or WebP. Change the file format above.
picportal.unsupportedMasks: Turn off “Export masks”: mask files are not published.

progress.hint: Keep PicPortal Editor open until the upload finishes.

picportal.cancelled: Publication cancelled. {{count}} photos already uploaded remain in the gallery.
picportal.reconnectToResume: Sign in again to resume. Photos already uploaded will not be sent twice.

errors.offline: Cannot reach PicPortal. Check your connection, then try again.
errors.timeout: PicPortal is taking too long to respond. Try again.
errors.server: PicPortal is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.forbidden: This account cannot publish to this gallery.
errors.galleryNotFound: This gallery no longer exists. Refresh the list and choose another.
errors.fileTooLarge: “{{name}}” is too large for PicPortal. Reduce its size in Image sizing.
errors.derivativesDisabled: PicPortal does not accept locally prepared photos for this account right now.
errors.renderFailed: “{{name}}” could not be prepared for upload.
errors.galleryCreateFailed: The gallery could not be created. Check the fields and try again.
errors.generic: Publication failed. Try again; if it happens again, copy the technical details.
